Wait, but path A actually continues to (9,7) rather than stopping mid-grid — checking that cell confirms it's marked as a neighbor of a crossing point, so the path is still consistent. Checking example 2 differences between marked coordinates doesn't reveal a clean lattice spacing either, so I should test with a fresh grid — maybe one with a point exactly centered and another with a point off toward a corner, to see how the growth pattern behaves more clearly.
